entities.name: Simeon Roksandić
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Simeon Roksandić was a Serbian sculptor and academic, famous for his bronzes and fountains. He is frequently cited as one of the most renowned figures in Serbian and Yugoslavian sculpture.
